walkthroughs.title: AXIS: first plot
walkthroughs.description: Open the example study, confirm bars (Sample/CSV), and run it. Choose hosted (pynescript.online), this computer, or the in-editor subset.

steps.title: Open the fixture
steps.description:
Opens `orb.pine` and the sibling chart (`barsPath` → `sample-bars.csv`). Sample candles are on by default; use **AXIS: Pick Data** for Sample or CSV, or open `examples/`.
[Open fixture](command:axis.openWalkthroughFixture)

steps.title: Run Script
steps.description:
Confirm bars (Sample default, Pick Data, or the fixture CSV), then press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) or **AXIS: Run Script**. The default engine sends the script to pynescript.online. No API key. **AXIS: Choose How to Run** can switch to this computer, or to the in-editor subset (`uploaded=0`).
[Run Script](command:axis.runScript)

steps.title: Optional: full local engine
steps.description:
Install the engine on this computer when the script should stay here. It runs the full PYNE runtime (Numba, sessions, optimize). The in-editor engine is only a subset.
[Install Local Engine](command:axis.engine.setup)

axis.telemetry.offline.description: Keep product telemetry off by default in IDE.

axis.engine.mode.markdownDescription: Engine selection. `server` (default) posts to `#axis.engine.endpoint#` — the hosted `pynescript.online` endpoint, keyless. `local` starts the managed `pyne-backend` sidecar on loopback. `pyodide` forces the Wasm calculator. `auto` prefers local when provisioned, else `server`.

axis.engine.endpoint.markdownDescription: PYNE Pro / engine base URL (no `/run` suffix). Defaults to the hosted `pynescript.online` endpoint, which is keyless (`X-AXIS-Client: ide`). The official host is always allowed; other remote URLs require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`.

axis.engine.local.command.markdownDescription: Command for the managed local engine. Defaults to the `pyne-backend` console script from the `hoox-pyne-backend` wheel. For a checkout, use `python3` with args `-m backend`.

axis.engine.local.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#axis.engine.local.command#`. Example for a checkout: `["-m", "backend"]`.

axis.engine.local.cwd.markdownDescription: Working directory for the local engine (repo checkout). Empty runs from the extension host cwd.

axis.engine.local.python.markdownDescription: Python 3.10–3.13 executable used by **AXIS: Install Local Engine** to create the extension-owned venv under `globalStorage/pyne-engine`. Ignored once `axis.engine.local.command` points at an installed backend.

axis.engine.local.package.markdownDescription: pip package spec installed by **AXIS: Install Local Engine**. Use a local path, wheel, or private-index spec when `hoox-pyne-backend` is not on the default index (for example `/path/to/pynescript/packages/backend`).

axis.engine.local.allowDownload.markdownDescription: When the default `python3` is missing or outside 3.10–3.13, **AXIS: Install Local Engine** downloads a pinned standalone CPython 3.12 build (~50 MB, SHA-256 verified) from python-build-standalone into `globalStorage/pyne-runtime`. Disable for air-gapped machines and set `#axis.engine.local.python#` instead.

axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint.markdownDescription: When false (default), non-official remote endpoints are rejected so a Pro Bearer key is not sent off-machine. The official `pynescript.online` host is always allowed. **Application (user) scope only** — workspace settings cannot enable remote endpoints. Opt in only for trusted remote Pro hosts.

axis.engine.allowPyodide.markdownDescription: Gate for the explicit `pyodide` engine mode. Pyodide 0.29.5 ships in the VSIX (`vendor/pyodide/0.29.5`); the host falls back to jsDelivr into `globalStorage` only when the bundle is missing. `ready` after a 1+1 smoke plus pynescript Runtime smoke (trusted hoox-pyne wheel). Source is **not** uploaded (`uploaded=0`). Numba/R2/cron are not available in Wasm. `server` and `local` are unaffected; set false to disable the Wasm calculator entirely.

axis.engine.pyodideWheelUrl.markdownDescription: Optional `https://` or `file://` URL (or filesystem path) of a trusted `hoox-pyne` / pynescript `py3-none-any` wheel for Pyodide micropip. Empty uses `media/pyodide/` then sibling `pynescript/dist`. Wasm is never this setting.

axis.chart.historyBars.markdownDescription: Default OHLCV history window for new chart sessions and when the document omits a positive `historyBars`. Counts are clamped to **20000** (same as this maximum).

axis.chart.useMockBars.markdownDescription: When true (default), chart sessions and runs use deterministic Sample/mock candles so a Marketplace install paints and runs without a sidecar or `ccxt`. Set false to fetch real OHLCV from `#axis.datafeed.source#` (sidecar at `#axis.datafeed.url#`, or venue via ccxt when installed).

axis.datafeed.url.markdownDescription: Base URL for the local `@hoox-sh/axis-datafeed` sidecar (`GET /datafeed/ohlcv`). Defaults to loopback `:5003`. Remote URLs require `#axis.engine.allowRemoteEndpoint#`.

enumDescriptions: Local axis-datafeed sidecar at axis.datafeed.url (default when Sample candles are off).
Opt-in live/historical OHLCV via ccxt (default exchange binance). Marketplace VSIX does not ship ccxt; without it AXIS falls back to Sample candles.
axis.datafeed.source.markdownDescription: OHLCV history source when `#axis.chart.useMockBars#` is false. `sidecar` (default) fetches from the local axis-datafeed sidecar at `#axis.datafeed.url#` — the desk and Pick Data label this **Local feed**. `venue` is opt-in live/historical OHLCV via ccxt (default binance) when `ccxt` is installed in the extension host — labeled **Venue** on the desk; the Marketplace VSIX does not ship ccxt — without it AXIS falls back to Sample candles instead of leaving the chart empty.

axis.statusbar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the AXIS status-bar button (symbol, timeframe, and run state). Click it to open the AXIS side panel. Turn off to hide the button. The command menu stays on **AXIS: Show AXIS Menu**.

axis.profiler.enabled.markdownDescription: Time run stages (engine, paint, delta, step). **AXIS: Show Last Run Profile** shows the last one. The status-bar button opens the AXIS side panel.

axis.debug.adapter.markdownDescription: Bar debug adapter. 'executable' (default) runs the real out-of-process axis-bar DAP adapter (`out/debug/adapter.js`) over stdio. 'inline' keeps the in-process adapter for the extension host process. DAP type stays `axis-bar` (never `pyne`).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run vendor:pyodide && npm run compile
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:coverage:gate
scripts.test: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && node out/test/runTest.js
